list.positionDisplay: AVP/Manager, Accounting (Retail Finance & Credit Card Dept)
list.responsibility:
Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the daily settlement of credit card and acquiring business, including transaction data verification and fund collection and payment settlement of card issuance and acquiring transactions with card organizations, and daily check settlement, transaction adjustment, abnormal transaction reconciliation and other accounting processing of credit card and acquiring business.
  • Responsible for the management accounting of credit card and acquiring business, including the account management of transaction funds receivable and payable accounts in credit card and acquiring business, accounting bookkeeping rules design and adjustment, account balance monitoring and analysis, etc.
  • Responsible for the reporting of accounting and financial data related to credit card and acquiring business. According to the requirements of management and external supervision, regularly provide credit card and acquiring business, accounts, transactions, funds, charges, risks, loan balances and other credit card and acquiring business related data reports.
  • Responsible for the analysis of credit card and acquiring business operations. Based on business development needs, sort out and build the data assets and reporting system of credit card and acquiring business from the bottom up, conduct business analysis on financial models, revenue structure analysis, transaction trend, user transaction activity and cross-customer penetration operations, product pricing and other topics, and provide business diagnosis and strategic decision-making suggestions to the management.
list.jobRequirement:
Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree or above, major in financial management, accounting, economics and finance is preferred. More than 5 years of accounting and financial management related work experience, retail credit and credit card related experience is preferred.
  • Possess solid accounting processing capabilities, financial management and accounting analysis capabilities, and be competent for the establishment of accounting systems based on business development needs and process system construction that meets regulatory and audit requirements. CPA/ACCA accounting professional qualification certificates are preferred.
  • Have good business analysis capabilities

list.responsibility:
Retail Banking Trainee 2026

We invest in talent through strategic growth platforms. Our Trainee Program shapes future leaders for management succession and organizational impact.


Retail Banking Overview

The Retail Banking Line drives the Bank’s frontline growth, delivering comprehensive financial services through an extensive branch and digital network in Hong Kong. Managing 28 branches, it oversees end-to-end retail operations—including customer acquisition, service delivery, risk compliance, and remote customer service—to serve diverse segments and products.

 

Stream you can choose

1.     Retail Finance Management (Digital Focus)

2.     Private Banking & Wealth Management

3.     Customer Segmentation Management

4.     Retail Branch Business Development

5.     Digital Banking Management

6.     Securities Products

7.     Retail Finance Operations Management

8.     Wealth Product Management
list.jobRequirement:
Requirements

· Proactive, self-motivated and a good team player

 

· Excellent communication and analytical skills

 

· Strong passions to develop career in banking profession

 

· Proficient in both spoken and written English and Chinese, fluent Putonghua is a plus

 

· Bachelor's Degree or above from an accredited university

 

· Immediate available is preferred


Please indicate your preferred stream in your resume to assist us in evaluating your profile for relevant opportunities.

list.responsibility:
• Monitor development of cash management projects and ensure smoothness of progress with in-time delivery
  • Define strategies and positioning for cash management products & services, coordinating with stakeholders
  • Develop and execute product/pricing strategy to garner new deposits and achieve target growth in market share
  • Ensure clear understanding of product capabilities across various customer touch-points, including relationship managers, sales, and client management through proactive communication and training programs
  • Address day to day business process matters such as technical support, operational issues, client servicing support, legal documentation
  • Support origination efforts for liabilities related deals by closely working with sales, implementation and relationship managers
  • Act as back-up for the liquidity management product manager, to drive commercialization and support sales & RMs in deals when required
  • Carry out data analytics to identify leads for growing operating balances and enhance cross-sell through data-driven operating model
  • Occasional business travel is required
list.jobRequirement:
• At least 3 years or above working experience in financial services or E-commerce services, and familiar with market developments
  • Degree holder or above in Finance, Computer Science or relevant education background
  • Strong research and analytical skills with ability to identify trends, make business conclusions and provide actionable insights from data
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build cooperative working relationships with stakeholders and effectively convey information
  • Strong interpersonal, communication skills and strong organizational skills
